mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/wire-format.md <<'EOF'
# Wire serialisation format

The project's current recorded decision is to use CBOR (Concise Binary Object Representation) as the wire serialisation format, chosen for its stronger standardisation and to avoid the version-compatibility problems previously encountered.

cat docs/policies/wire-format.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/wire-format.md`. It states that the current recorded decision is CBOR, chosen for stronger standardisation and to avoid version-compatibility problems.

The only record I found is in the project's memory. It holds two serialisation decisions from the same session: msgpack, then CBOR "instead of msgpack". I treated CBOR as the current one and left msgpack out of the file, as you asked.

The repo has no written decision on this. Its code still has msgpack binding and render files (`binding/msgpack.go`, `render/msgpack.go`), so the code doesn't match the CBOR decision yet.
